CustomField.description: Offer answer of a migration campaign: Opportunity name = {prefix}{account name} ({debtor number}). Set on the main (parent) campaign; a child without its own value uses the parent's. When the name would exceed 120 characters, "voorstel voor " is dropped from the prefix. Empty = old format (callback label - account).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Start of the Opportunity name, e.g. "2g/4g migratievoorstel voor ". Result: prefix + account name + (debtor number).
CustomField.label: Opportunity Name Prefix
